faq1.question: How long does a typical project take to complete?
faq1.answer: Project timelines depend on the complexity, features, and requirements. Simple Python scripts or automation tools may take a few days, while Flutter applications, AI/ML projects, or complete software solutions typically take several weeks to a few months. After discussing your project, I'll provide a clear timeline and development plan.

faq2.question: What technologies do you work with?
faq2.answer: I primarily work with <figmaAdobe>Python, Flutter, Firebase, and AI/ML technologies</figmaAdobe>. I also build REST APIs, automation tools, and data-driven applications. My goal is to create <codeAccuratelyReflects>efficient, scalable, and user-friendly solutions</codeAccuratelyReflects> that solve real-world problems.

faq3.question: What makes your development process unique?
faq3.answer: My development process focuses on <communicationCollaborationQuality>clear communication, continuous learning, and writing high-quality code</communicationCollaborationQuality>. I prioritize clean architecture, maintainable code, and practical solutions. Whether it's a Flutter app, Python automation, or an AI-powered application, I aim to deliver <robustScalableProduct>reliable, scalable, and future-ready software</robustScalableProduct>.

faq4.question: Do you provide support after project completion?
faq4.answer: Yes. I offer <supportMaintenancePackages>ongoing support, maintenance, and feature improvements</supportMaintenancePackages> after project delivery. This includes bug fixes, performance optimization, updates, and technical assistance to ensure your application continues to run smoothly. I can also create a <tailoredPlan>custom support plan based on your project's requirements</tailoredPlan>.
